name: ab_t2_sum_mul_divisors
statement: (n k : ℕ) (hn : Nat.Perfect n) : ∑ d ∈ Nat.divisors n, k * d = 2 * (k * n)
closed: ∀ (n k : ℕ) (hn : Nat.Perfect n), ∑ d ∈ Nat.divisors n, k * d = 2 * (k * n)
informal: Table 2 step 8: sum of k d_i over divisors d_i of perfect n equals 2kn.
type: ∀ (n k : ℕ), n.Perfect → ∑ d ∈ n.divisors, k * d = 2 * (k * n)
